audit.whatIsWrong: Three-way disagreement: full phases[].side is 'Skill' on all seven rows, content win[] gives Cassiopeia six of seven, and the packet flags that against a 52.14% Ekko win rate.
audit.why: Both extremes are wrong. Pre-6 Cassiopeia genuinely owns it — Noxious Blast is a 3.5s cooldown at 850 range, Twin Fang fires every 0.75s and heals her, and Miasma grounds Ekko's only gap-closer. From level 6 Chronobreak (110s) beats Petrifying Gaze (120s) as a commit tool, and that is where the win rate comes from.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 to Cassiopeia, rows 4-6 to Ekko, with both layers and all whys moved together.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was written as Cassiopeia's, so the page never states where Ekko's power actually arrives.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110/80/50 against a 120/100/80 Petrifying Gaze; that ratio is the whole reason the matchup flips.
audit.corrected: phases[4], whys[4], whys[5] and the content 'mid' paragraph now put the flip at 6 with the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions are unstated: Miasma grounds Ekko's E specifically (his only escape at 325 range), and Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia off every 0.75s tick, so extended trades need Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's Miasma text: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities'. Twin Fang: 'heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt'. The missingInteractions entry flags the anti-heal case.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, enemyWin and report[8].t now state both, with Oblivion Orb named.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Miasma 24s/16s, Twin Fang 0.75s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen fields called Cassiopeia 'he/his/him', and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js marks cassiopeia female; the templates were written for a male enemy.
audit.corrected: Every flagged non-report field rewritten with correct pronouns and its own content; two report entries fixed within the report cap, the rest listed in notes.
